title: Clarity of Scripture
definition: The clarity of Scripture means that God's essential message can be understood by ordinary believers through careful reading, prayer, and dependence on the Holy Spirit.
summary: Not every passage is equally easy to understand, but God has communicated clearly enough that people can know the Gospel, understand His commands, and grow in faith.
christFocus: The Scriptures clearly reveal Jesus Christ as Savior and Lord. God's purpose is not to hide salvation from people but to make Christ known.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's Word is understandable. Believers benefit from teachers and study tools, but Scripture is not reserved for scholars alone.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: The clarity of Scripture encourages believers to read God's Word for themselves and trust that God is able to teach His people through it.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Read Scripture regularly. Pray for wisdom. Compare Scripture with Scripture. Trust that God can teach you through His Word.
